evidence: Searched the reply and both files for asserted costs, retention, credentials/access, download mechanism/URL scheme, metrics, dates, outcomes, and alternatives. Dates, cost, retention, credentials and other alternatives are left as open questions, and the credentials/retention trade-off is attributed to the original doc. One download-mechanism assertion remains, and neither the user nor the original doc established it: mini-doc line 29, "Como o arquivo não depende mais do disco de um worker específico, qualquer worker pode atender o download." This states that workers still serve the download. Open question 2 (line 47) treats exactly that as unknown ("a API ou o worker lê do bucket e devolve o arquivo, ou o usuário recebe um link direto para o bucket?"). Line 35 also asserts an outcome ("o que elimina o 404 que motivou a mudança"), which is only implied by the user's past tense "caía". The line-29 assertion is at least borderline, and the rules say borderline is unmet.
